display_long_description:
Step up to the table and experience classic pinball like never before in 3D Pinball VR: Arcade Simulator.

Inspired by the simple, addictive computer pinball games many players grew up with, this VR pinball experience brings old-school arcade action into an immersive virtual world.

Launch the ball, control responsive flippers, hit bumpers and targets, activate bonuses, build multipliers, complete challenges, and keep your run alive as you chase your highest score.

Whether you remember classic 3D pinball from old computers or simply love arcade games and pinball machines, the gameplay is designed to be easy to learn and difficult to master. Every shot can increase your score, trigger a combo, or push you closer to a new personal record.

Features:

• Immersive VR pinball gameplay
• Classic 3D pinball and retro arcade feel
• Responsive flipper and ball physics
• High-score and score-attack gameplay
• Combos, bonuses, targets, and challenges
• Fast, replayable arcade sessions
• Comfortable seated or standing play
• Simple controls with instant pick-up-and-play action

Relive the excitement of classic computer pinball, master the table, and see how high you can score in this nostalgic VR arcade simulator.
